issues.description: The SNMP daemon (snmpd) fails to start, and SNMP polling stops working, when an SNMP text field (such as the SNMP Location or Contact) contains a non-ASCII character, such as an en dash (–), and the configuration is committed. The failure persists across reboots and process restarts.
issues.workaround: Replace any non-ASCII characters in the SNMP fields with standard ASCII characters (for example, replace an en dash with a hyphen), and then commit the configuration.

issues.description: Panorama can report a selective commit and push to a managed firewall as successful even when a rename operation in the push does not apply. As a result, the push can unintentionally delete configurations on the firewall.
